name: Invalid FSM State Transition: Direct Draft to Shipped
description: Order lifecycle test attempts to transition order from 'DRAFT' directly to 'SHIPPED', skipping mandatory 'CONFIRMED' state.

failure_vector.error_log: IllegalStateTransitionException: Cannot transition Order from state 'DRAFT' to 'SHIPPED'. Must be 'CONFIRMED' first.

expected_resolution.healed_code: order = Order.create(); order.confirm_payment(); order.process_fulfillment(); order.mark_as_shipped(); assert order.status == 'SHIPPED'
